item.tib: che mchog dran pa yang gsang drag po'i rgyud che mchog rigs lnga yab yum bzlog pa
item.coloph: bdag 'dra o rgyan sangs rgyas gling pas rab brten lcags mo phag lo'i zla tshes nyin par las/ ka ke'u nyi ma rang shar gnas kyi pho brang g.yon phyogs mkha' 'gro seng gdong phug nas/ rigs mthun gyi Dak+ki'i grogs mdzad de spyan drangs shing / slar zla tshes la mi dbang bsod nams nor bu'i pho brang drug zur rnam rgyal rdzong gi dbus rtse nas mkha' 'gro'i shog ser bod yig du (tu) phab grub pa'o//
